paper.title_en: Conformal boundaries and the photon sphere of AdS black holes
paper.abstract_en: We study linearized gravitational perturbations of four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with finite timelike boundaries subject to conformal boundary conditions. These fix the conformal class of the induced metric and the mean curvature, while allowing the boundary Weyl mode to fluctuate. The photon sphere plays a distinguished role in this problem: a static boundary at this radius is totally umbilic, and the scalar problem separates exactly into independent bulk and boundary sectors. We prove the absence of exponentially growing scalar and vector modes for spherical harmonics of degree two and higher. We determine how large angular momentum instabilities are suppressed as the boundary approaches umbilicity. Near the horizon, we recover the universal Rindler spectrum, including sound and shear excitations. We numerically follow these fluid modes as the boundary is moved outwards and find that they approach standard gravitational quasinormal modes at the asymptotic AdS$_4$ boundary. For large black holes, these asymptotic endpoints correspond to the sound and shear poles of the dual three-dimensional conformal field theory. We also study perturbations of the AdS$_4$ black brane, where we find an analogous continuation of the fluid modes in the absence of an intermediate umbilic boundary.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究带共形边界条件的Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞线性化引力扰动，涉及光子球、拟正规模与对偶CFT流体模式，理论深度较高且给出了数值延续结果，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 共形边界与AdS黑洞的光子球
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究四维Schwarzschild-AdS黑洞在有限类时边界并受共形边界条件约束下的线性化引力扰动。这些条件固定诱导度规的共形类与平均曲率，同时允许边界Weyl模式涨落。光子球在此问题中扮演特殊角色：该半径处的静态边界是全脐的，标量问题精确分离为独立的体与边界扇区。我们证明对于度数为二及以上的球谐函数，不存在指数增长的标量与矢量模式。我们确定当边界趋近全脐时，大角动量不稳定性如何被抑制。在视界附近，我们恢复普适的Rindler谱，包括声波与剪切激发。随着边界向外移动，我们用数值方法追踪这些流体模式，发现它们在渐近AdS$_4$边界处趋近标准引力拟正规模。对于大黑洞，这些渐近端点对应于对偶三维共形场论中的声波与剪切极点。我们还研究了AdS$_4$黑膜的扰动，在缺乏中间全脐边界的情况下，发现了流体模式的类似延续。
